 for the petitioner.

** **
Jasjit Singh Bedi, J.

The prayer in this fifth petition under Section 483 of Bnss is for the grant of regular bail in case
bearing Fir No.363 dated 20.10.2023 under Sections 34, 120-B, 201, 307 and 420 Ipc and Sections
25-29-54-59 of the Arms Act registered at Police Station Civil Line, District Sonipat, Haryana.

2.  The present FIR came to be registered at the instance of Abhishek alias Rajan and reads as under:-
To, the SHO, Police Station Civil Line, Sonipat.
Sir, it is requested that I, Abhishek alias Rajan son of Mr. Raj Kumar, an the resident of Near Ram Mandir, Jeevan Nagar, Sonipat.
On 20/10/23, at around 03.30 PM, I was sitting with Vikash on the pods in front of Sanjay's shop.
Then three boys namely Dharuv son of Jagdish, Vishal son of Rajesh and Rohit alias Roti son of Madan, all residents f Tara Nagar, Sonipat came on a motorcycle.

About 6-7 months ago, I had a fight with above said 1 of 3 CRM-M-5119-2026 (O & M) ::2::
::2::
Dhruv vs State Of Haryana on 4 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16152335/
1 boys, today, Daruv, Vishal, Rohit with intention to kill me, Dhruv fired a bullet at me which hit my left leg and all the accused fled away from the spot on their motor cycle.
Legal action taken against them.
SD Abhishek.
3. The learned counsel for the petitioner contends that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The allegations levelled are baseless.

The co-accused of the petitioner, namely,
Paras Malik, Vishal @ Chopra and Rohit @ Roti have been granted the concession of bail.
As he is in custody since 24.10.2023, he be granted the concession of bail.
4. The learned counsel for the State, on the other hand, contends that the petitioner is the main accused having fired at the leg of the complainant.
The recovery of the country-made pistol has been effected from him.
He is an accused in multiple cases.
The instant fifth petition seeking the grant of regular bail has been filed without any change in circumstances and his last bail application was withdrawn as recently as on 27.10.2025.
Therefore, he is not entitled to the concession of bail.
5. I have heard the learned counsel for the parties.
6. Admittedly, as per the prosecution case, the petitioner is the main accused having fired at and injuring the complainant-Abhishek @ Rajan.
He is a habitual offender with multiple cases registered against him.
The instant petition has been filed without any change in circumstances whatsoever and the last bail application of the petitioner was withdrawn only on 27.10.2025.

7. In view of the above, I find no merit in the present petition and the same stands dismissed.
 2 of 3  CRM-M-5119-2026 (O & M) ::3::
 ::3::
8.

In view of the fact that the petitioner is filing repeated petitions seeking the grant of bail without any significant change in circumstances, he is directed to deposit the costs of Rs.10,000/- with Spinal Rehab Centre, Chandigarh Plot No.1, Madhya Marg, Sector 28-A, Chandigarh, 0172- 4610311 within 15 days and on failure of which the Registry shall place the matter before the Court.
9.
The pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of accordingly.

(JASJIT SINGH BEDI)
